core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Swiss Typographic precision meets Tactile Materiality.
Emotion First: The app should feel 'Efficient' and 'Sharp' - like a well-tailored suit.
Content is King: Data clarity is paramount. Verification is the hero action.
Zoom In: Use focus modes for data review to prevent cognitive overload.
design_philosophy.theme_strategy: Smart Hybrid (Light Mode default for legibility, Dark Mode for low-light environments)

rules: Use 'tracking-tight' for all headings larger than 24px.
Use 'tracking-widest' for all overline labels (e.g., 'RECENT SCANS').

forbidden: Gradients for backgrounds (Use solid or noise only)

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg (8px) for inputs, rounded-xl (12px) for cards, rounded-full for buttons
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border. On active/focus: 2px solid ring-offset-2
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to reduce digital sterility (optional).

layout_strategy.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto md:max-w-2xl lg:max-w-4xl xl:max-w-6xl px-4 md:px-8
layout_strategy.bento_rules: Use 'The Tetris Grid' for the dashboard. Hero block (Project Summary) takes full width. Action blocks (Scan, Import) share a row.

buttons.primary: h-12 px-6 rounded-full font-semibold shadow-sm transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: h-12 px-6 rounded-full border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground
buttons.icon: h-12 w-12 rounded-full p-0 flex items-center justify-center

inputs.default: h-12 bg-background border-input px-4 rounded-lg focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:opacity-50
inputs.file_upload: border-2 border-dashed border-muted-foreground/25 hover:border-accent/50 transition-colors rounded-xl p-8 text-center cursor-pointer

cards.contact: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border shadow-sm p-4 flex items-center gap-4 transition-all hover:border-primary/20
cards.project: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-all

navigation.bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 border-t bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-lg p-2 flex justify-around items-center z-50 safe-area-bottom
navigation.fab: fixed bottom-20 right-6 h-14 w-14 rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center z-40

transitions.page_enter: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
transitions.list_item: initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} transition={{ delay: index * 0.05 }}

empty_states.description: Minimalist abstract 3d shape or line art representing potential
Close up of business card on clean desk

rules: Touch targets must be at least 44x44px.
Text contrast must be WCAG AA compliant (4.5:1).
Focus rings must be visible on all interactive elements.
Form inputs must have associated labels.

camera_overlay.style: absolute inset-0 border-2 border-white/50 rounded-lg m-8 pointer-events-none
camera_overlay.guide_text: absolute bottom-12 left-0 right-0 text-center text-white text-sm font-medium shadow-black/50 drop-shadow-md

review_interface.layout: Split view on desktop, Stack view on mobile.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds.
All interactive elements must have data-testid.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the PWA with a focus on 'Tactile Utility'. The app should feel like a physical tool. Use the 'Manrope' font for all headings to give it a distinct technical look. Prioritize the scanning flow - it must be fast and obvious. Ensure the 'Review' interface is extremely legible, as users will be editing text often.
